summary: Food retail: sales floor with chilled and frozen display, back-of-house cold rooms, goods reception, waste and returns handling, and optionally manual counters (deli, fish, bake-off) where unpackaged food is handled. It is a butiksutrymme in verksamhetsklass 2A/2B and a livsmedelsanläggning that must be registered with the municipal food control (LIVSFS 2022:8). Hygiene rules (EU 852/2004 Annex II) require hand-wash basins, staff WCs that do not open into food rooms, changing facilities where needed and waste storage, but no sizes. Heavy goods flows make the goods reception (AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 32 §) and floor loads the typical blockers in an office building.

regulatory.bbr_verksamhetsklass: 2A (≤150 persons) or 2B (>150 persons) — BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 11–12 §§ 'butiksutrymmen'. See cross_cutting.json fire_vk_2abc.

key_laws.ref: Förordning (EG) nr 852/2004 om livsmedelshygien, bilaga II
LIVSFS 2022:8 Livsmedelsverkets föreskrifter om registrering och godkännande

permits: Bygglov for change of use from office (PBL 9 kap. 15 § 1, see cross_cutting.json cou_bygglov_trigger); detaljplan must allow Detaljhandel (H) or Centrum (C).
Anmälan (PBF 6 kap. 1 §) for ventilation, VA (incl. any grease separator), refrigeration-related structural or fire changes.

Registration of the livsmedelsanläggning: written notification to the municipal control authority (LIVSFS 2022:8 2 §, 6 §); activity may start when registered, or two weeks after the notification arrived even if not yet registered (9 §).
Municipal VA approval/notification of grease separator where required by local ABVA rules.

gross_m2_per_unit.source: BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 4 § p. 1: affärslokal 0.5 persons/m2 if the maximum is not known (egress design density for the customer area, not a trading density).

staff_per_unit.source: No public Swedish source found for staff per m2 in grocery retail.

egress_design_density.source: BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 4 § p. 1. At this density a sales area above ~300 m2 exceeds 150 persons and becomes vk 2B.

occupancy.hourly_presence_note: Modelling assumption (indicative, not sourced): long opening hours (~7–22) with after-work peak 16–19; early-morning staff/deliveries.

spaces.label_en: Sales floor with chilled/frozen display and checkouts

required.basis: Defining space; size is a business decision.

spaces.notes: Imposed load D1 retail 4.0 kN/m2 vs B office 2.5 kN/m2 (BFS 2024:6, cross_cutting.json loads_imposed_table_4_1). Fire/egress per vk 2A/2B (cross_cutting.json). Checkout staff are permanent workplaces: daylight/view per AFS 2023:12 5 kap. 25 § or compensating measures.

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 32 §: goods reception when needed, designed for the activity; a business loading and unloading large amounts of goods shall normally have a goods reception with a loading dock. 34 §: dock needs at least one access from ground, normally a stair. 35 §: outdoor goods reception used more than temporarily normally roofed. 33 § allmänna råd: ≥0.7 m pedestrian clearance between vehicles.

spaces.notes: Truck access and turning on the site/street is usually decisive in office districts. If goods move between floors: lift requirement AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 15 §.

spaces.label_en: Cold and freezer rooms, dry stock

required.basis: Cold chain is a food-law duty (EU 852/2004 Annex II, believed ch. IX — not verified in this session); dedicated cold/freezer rooms are the practice solution, not a stated room requirement.

spaces.notes: Ch. IX reference was not re-read in this session (confidence of the basis: sourced from general knowledge of 852/2004 — verify). Insulated floors raise floor level; goods storage loads E1 5.0 kN/m2 (cross_cutting.json).

required.basis: Technical necessity for chilled/frozen display; not a regulated room.

spaces.shareable_note: Waste heat can serve other building uses.
spaces.notes: Condensers on roof or yard need space and noise control towards neighbours (BFS 2024:10 buller and municipal noise guidance — not checked here).

spaces.label_en: Manual service counter / food preparation (deli, fish, bake-off)

required.basis: Optional; if present, EU 852/2004 Annex II ch. II applies (design permitting good hygiene, cleaning facilities for tools, food-washing facilities where necessary) and ch. I p. 4 hand-wash basins.

spaces.notes: Bake-off ovens and hot food need exhaust; floor drains are not a requirement per Livsmedelsverket kontrollwiki (art. 343) but are suitable where unpackaged sensitive foods are handled.

required.basis: EU 852/2004 Annex II ch. I p. 4: adequate number of washbasins, suitably located and designated for cleaning hands, with hot and cold running water and hygienic drying. Livsmedelsverket kontrollwiki (art. 1045): where necessary separate from food-rinsing equipment.

size.count: at each area where unpackaged food is handled and at staff WCs
size.source: No number or size in law or guidance ('tillräckligt antal').

required.basis: EU 852/2004 Annex II ch. I p. 3 (adequate flush lavatories, not opening directly into food-handling rooms), p. 9 (adequate changing facilities where necessary); AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 40–58 §§ (see cross_cutting.json staff_* and san_workplace). Kontrollwiki: staff carrying unpackaged food need a suitable place to change; staff route to changing should not pass unpackaged-food areas.

size.count: 1 WC per started 15 employees (AFS 2023:12 allmänna råd to 3 kap. 56 §)
size.source: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 58 § allmänna råd: accessible WC ≥2.2 x 2.2 m. Changing room size: none.

spaces.notes: Customer WCs are not required by food law (kontrollwiki art. 1045: up to the operator) nor by Boverket (only accessible if provided).

spaces.label_en: Waste, food waste, cardboard and bottle-return room

required.basis: EU 852/2004 Annex II ch. VI p. 1–4 (food waste removed from food rooms, closable containers, adequate storage and disposal provision, pest-free); BFS 2024:8 11 kap. 1–3 §§ (waste rooms located/dimensioned for hygiene and collection).

size.source: No size; Livsmedelsverket kontrollwiki (art. 343): food law cannot be used to demand a cooled waste room only because of odour.

spaces.shareable_note: Shared waste room at building level.
spaces.notes: Bottle/can returns (pant) and cardboard baler are practice; space-demanding.

required.basis: Municipal VA rules (ABVA/riktlinjer). Example: MittSverige Vatten & Avfall (Sundsvall) lists grocery stores among businesses required to have a grease separator per SS-EN 1825-1/-2; small or packaged-only businesses can apply for exemption. BFS 2024:8 8 kap. 15 §: WC wastewater may not be connected to grease separators.

size.count: sized per SS-EN 1825-2 from fat-laden flow

spaces.shareable_note: One separator can serve several food tenants if drainage allows.
spaces.notes: Relevant mainly with deli/bake-off/fish counters. Municipal guides commonly say it may not be placed in a room where food is handled and needs emptying access for a suction truck.

variants.label: Convenience store (≤150 persons, 2A)
variants.changes: Mostly packaged goods; minimal food handling; possibly exempt from grease separator; goods delivered through front or small rear door.

variants.label: Supermarket (>150 persons, 2B)
variants.changes: Loading dock normally required for large goods volumes (AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 32 §); manual counters; fire alarm and evacuation alarm (2B).

typical_blockers: Detaljplan K does not cover retail; needs H or C.
Goods reception with dock and truck access in an office street.
Floor load D1 4.0 kN/m2 (+ cold-room and storage loads) vs office B 2.5 kN/m2.
Change to vk 2A/2B: 30 m travel distance, exits, alarms (cross_cutting.json fire_vk_2abc).
Space for refrigeration condensers and their noise.
typical_enablers: Large, column-free ground floors with street frontage.
Existing goods lift and basement storage.

open_questions: EU 852/2004 Annex II ch. IX (temperature control) was not re-read in this session — verify wording before citing.
Grease-separator requirement for grocery stores varies by municipality; MSVA (Sundsvall) is one example. Stockholm Vatten och Avfall's page could not be retrieved.
Separate collection of food waste/bioavfall from businesses (avfallsförordningen 2020:614) likely drives waste-room size — paragraph not verified here.
No public Swedish source for back-of-house share or m2 per checkout.
BFS 2025:10 amendments to BFS 2024:7 not checked.
